description:
Where every planting on a block stands, and whether it finishes before frost.

Returns, per planting: heat accumulated since set-out against its target,
the projected date it reaches that target at the season's recent rate, and
a verdict on whether that lands before the median first frost.

One call answers the whole block. The season curve and the frost record are
shared across plantings, so asking about eight beds costs one round trip
rather than eight.

base_temp.description: Default base temperature in °F for plantings that do not set their own.

block.description: The ground to answer for: a block you have saved — its id, its name, one of its aliases, or any part of its name that only one block has (e.g. "Meadow" for "Lower Meadow"). If several match, the error lists them with their ids. Blocks may overlap; each answers for its own ground. Save one with block_save first; geometry travels once, not on every call.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

plantings.description: The block's plantings. Each is {"crop": "Lisianthus", "gdd_target": 1050, "set_out": "2026-07-06"} with an optional "base_temp" in °F when the crop counts from something other than the block default.

name: goodearth_crop_gdd_status
title: Crop heat status
